rows.note: Use 建議 as the all-purpose everyday word for advice or guidance.

example.english: I want to hear your counsel on this matter.
example.traditional: 我想聽吓你對呢件事嘅建議。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 deoi3 ne1 gin6 si6 ge3 gin3 ji5

rows.note: Use this when counsel means a consultation specifically about legal matters.

example.english: Before signing this contract, we sought legal counsel.
example.traditional: 簽呢份合約之前，我哋先做咗法律諮詢。
example.jyutping: cim1 ne1 fan6 hap6 joek3 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zou6 zo2 faat3 leot6 zi1 seon1

rows.note: Use this when counsel means someone's intended plan, purpose, or design rather than advice.

example.english: Their counsel is to move to Taiwan next year.
example.traditional: 佢嘅打算係下年搬去台灣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ge3 daa2 syun3 hai6 haa6 nin2 bun1 heoi3 toi1 waan1
